correctness.rationale: For GLMY regular Ω_1=A_1 over Z, each long arc (i,i+j) is chain-homologous to the sum of j unit arcs using allowed shortcut 2-paths. A unit-edge 1-cycle has constant coefficients, so all H1 is generated by the Hamiltonian cycle z_n. When 2k<n, positive residue winding W on all regular ordered edges cancels on every allowed elementary 2-path, even if its shortcut is forbidden, hence on ∂Ω_2; W(z_n)=n excludes torsion and vanishing. At k*=ceil(n/2), put a=k*,b=n-k*. The regular reciprocal path (0,a,0) plus integral shortening chains Q(0,a)+Q(a,b) is an Ω_2 chain of n-1 terms with literal boundary z_n. Thus H1=0 for k>=k*, and [z_n] persists by the identity chain for all 1<=k<k*. At k=0 there are n isolated vertices; reduced H0 has n-1 intervals [0,1). Rechecked n=3..12 integral death chain directly, not merely via rank over selected fields.
